claims.assertion: Swaruu says stellar travel is instantaneous externally but has ship-internal time: seven hours for a large craft and one hour forty minutes for a fighter.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes one eternal Whole, denies a Big Bang, and treats multiverses and density divisions as perceptual categories rather than separate universes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu identifies a painting Robert dates to 1561 as depicting the Battle for Alpha Centauri’s liberation, which she says reached Earth and included her current ship.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The date and artwork identification are reported by Robert.

proposed_topics.name: Battle for the liberation of Alpha Centauri
